name: Blopus — Web Search, Fetch & Images
description: Give your agent the open web: search, read full pages, and pull images — from an index Blopus crawls itself, not a reseller of another engine's results. blopus_search (freshness windows, domain filters, inline full text, hero images) + blopus_fetch (complete page text, 50 URLs per call) + image search (beta). Free key at blopus.ai

apiKey.title: Blopus API key
apiKey.description: Get one at https://blopus.ai — starts with blp_live_

blopus_search.summary: Web & news search over an independently crawled index. news_only for events, freshness to bound recency, include_domains/exclude_domains to constrain sources, include_content for inline full text, include_images for hero image URLs (free). Billed per block of 10 — count 1 and count 10 cost the same.

blopus_fetch.summary: Complete text of indexed pages. Batch up to 50 URLs in ONE call for the price of one search — always batch rather than looping. Unindexed URLs return in failed_results, not charged.
